title: Active-active serving, supported single writer
objective: Serve both regions; identify the real writer/consistency model instead of assuming multi-writer support.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
preconditions: Modern browser with local JavaScript; open index.html directly, with no server or framework
All regions, writers, replication, epochs, state, routing, reads, writes and journeys are fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY
Declared fixture: two serving origins, one writer region-one at epoch 7, optimistic revision checking, asynchronous readers and post-commit session minimum revision 11
Twelve observations per in-memory page session; reset retains history and the used allowance
actions: Inspect both serving regions without inferring writing capability
Verify the supported writer and read-your-writes contract
Compare stale-reader, missing-writer, fenced-epoch, optimistic-conflict and unsupported-local-writer traces
Inspect measured positive, negative and unknown checks, protective verifier versus user impact, and retained history
Reset current output and defaults by keyboard or mouse without discarding earlier outcomes

syntheticInputs.historyLifetime: In-memory page session; reset clears current output only, reload begins a new session

expectedAssertions: Both serving origins can succeed while only region-one is a supported writer; region-two forwards supported writes
Serving-only action produces positive serving checks but unknown writer, mutation and post-commit consistency proof
Supported epoch/revision and both revision-11 readers produce a positive synthetic contract observation
Region-two revision 10 fails the client minimum 11 despite successful serving; measured lag is 40 synthetic ms
Missing writer, epoch, committed effect, read and duration observations remain null and unknown, never successful or zero
Stale epoch and revision-conflict rejections protect the boundary but are negative requested user mutations with zero effects
Unsupported direct region-two writer attempts are rejected; multi-writer capability is not invented
Exact typed input/state guards replay every historical result and reject forged fields, accessors, inherited shapes, holes and counters
Reset retains all outcomes and allowance; real DOM, keyboard, focused error, exhausted allowance and page-owned CSP probes are observed
limits: DATA ONLY: no network/resource/data/configuration operations, management calls, identity, credentials, deployment or cloud spend
Fixed synthetic measurements, not live Azure or browser performance measurements
This declares one fictional supported writer model; it neither claims all Azure products are single-writer nor certifies any actual product's consistency or multi-writer support
